title: tc-engagement-quality
description:
Whether reviews are genuine: an index with its band and trend, the signals it is built from – each with its value,
what was observed, an explanation and an example – and an optional note on who else sees it.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

scope.description: What the numbers cover, a quiet line under the heading – e.g. "Last 5 sessions · 38 reviews"

index.description: The index, 0–1 (1: fully genuine). Unset, it is the weighted mean of the signals

signals.description: The signals behind the index, each 0–1 where higher means more genuine

trend.description: The index over recent windows, oldest first – drawn as small columns with the change

strongAt.description: Index from which the band reads "Strong" (0–1)

mixedAt.description: Index from which the band reads "Mixed"; below it, "Low" (0–1)

summary.description: Overrides the sentence under the index that says which signals hold it back

sharedWith.description: Who else sees the score – a role or a name, e.g. "your team lead". Unset: no note

browsable.description: Each signal's example offers "Show these reviews", which fires tc-signal-open

kind.description: One of the built-in kinds – supplies the label and explanation when they aren't given

reading.description: What was observed, in a few words – "Median 9 s with the source open"

explanation.description: What the signal measures and why it matters, in plain words

example.description: A concrete instance, shown when the person opens "Example"

weight.description: Share of the index when it is worked out from the signals (default 1)

EngagementWindow.description: One recent window of the index – a session, a week
